discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators have long been a top candidate in condensed matter physics. The work rests on a foundational theory (Kane-Mele, 2005) and a decisive experimental confirmation (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells, 2007), and it has had a broad impact on materials physics. It also follows on from the 2016 topology prize. With Shoucheng Zhang deceased, the Kane-Mele-Molenkamp trio is a clean fit for the three-laureate limit.
